items.summary: Remove the scroll-to-top button (SVG icon and its anchor wrapper) identified by XPath /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/div[3]/a[1]/svg[1] and /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/div[3]/a[1] — this is the floating scroll-to-top anchor element in the page layout.

Remove the paragraph element (REQ XPath: /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/main[1]/section[4]/div[1]/div[3]/p[1]) and the button element (XPath: /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/main[1]/section[4]/div[1]/div[3]/button[1]) from section 4 (likely the ServicesSection or a related section). Adjust surrounding layout to remain clean and smooth after removal.

Remove the logo text div from the header (XPath: /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/header[1]/div[1]/div[1]/a[1]/div[2]) — this is the text label next to the logo image in the Header component. Keep the logo image/icon intact; only remove the text div.

Remove the entire card/container div (XPath: /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/main[1]/section[7]/div[1]/div[2]/div[3]), including the inner content div (XPath: /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/main[1]/section[7]/div[1]/div[2]/div[3]/div[1]) and anchor link (XPath: /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/main[1]/section[7]/div[1]/div[2]/div[3]/a[1]) from section 7 (likely ContactSection or FAQSection). Adjust the grid or flex layout of the parent container so remaining cards/items fill the space evenly.

Add a clearly visible Terms & Policy link in the website footer (Footer.tsx). The link should navigate to the /terms route. Place it in the navigation links area of the footer alongside existing footer links. Ensure it is styled consistently with other footer links.
